definitions.mrr: mean(1 / first relevant session rank); 0 when no relevant session is retrieved
definitions.recall_at_k: macro mean of relevant sessions retrieved / all relevant sessions
definitions.recall_micro_at_k: total relevant sessions retrieved / total relevant sessions
definitions.recall_any_at_k: macro fraction with at least one relevant session retrieved
definitions.recall_all_at_k: macro fraction with every relevant session retrieved
definitions.ndcg_at_k: binary relevance DCG normalized by the ideal ordering of all evidence sessions
